policies.inbound:
<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("surface", "model") == "model")">
                <set-variable name="requestedModel" value="@{
                    if (context.Request.Method != "POST") { return ""; }
                    var body = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true);
                    return body?["model"]?.ToString() ?? "";
                }" />
                
                
                
                    
                        
                            
                            
                            
                            
                        
                        
                            
                                
                                    
                                    
                                        application/json
                                    
                                    
                                        model-denied
                                    
                                    
                                        model-entitlement
                                    
                                    
                                        @(context.RequestId.ToString())
                                    
                                    @(new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                        new JProperty("code", "ModelNotAllowed"),
                                        new JProperty("message", "Model '" + (string)context.Variables["requestedModel"] + "' is not allowed for the '{tier}' tier. Allowed models: {allowed-models}")))).ToString())
                                
                            
                            
                                
                                
                            
                        
                    
                
                
                
                    
                        <set-variable name="outputCapped" value="@{
                            var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                            foreach (var key in new [] { "max_completion_tokens", "max_tokens", "max_output_tokens" }) {
                                if (body[key] != null) { return (int)body[key] > {max-output-tokens}; }
                            }
                            return false;
                        }" />
                        @{
                            var body = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
                            body["model"] = (string)context.Variables["servedModel"];
                            string key = body["max_completion_tokens"] != null ? "max_completion_tokens"
                                : body["max_output_tokens"] != null ? "max_output_tokens"
                                : body["max_tokens"] != null ? "max_tokens"
                                : (body["messages"] == null && body["input"] != null) ? "max_output_tokens" : "max_tokens";
                            if (body[key] == null || (int)body[key] > {max-output-tokens}) { body[key] = {max-output-tokens}; }
                            return body.ToString();
                        }
                        
                            
                                
                                
                                    
                                    
                                    
                                    
                                
                            
                        
                    
                
                
                
            
            
            <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("surface", "") == "tool" && context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("toolName", "") != "")">
                
                    
                        
                            
                            
                            
                            
                        
                        
                            
                            
                                application/json
                            
                            
                                tool-denied
                            
                            
                                tool-entitlement
                            
                            
                                @(context.RequestId.ToString())
                            
                            @(new JObject(
                                new JProperty("jsonrpc", "2.0"),
                                new JProperty("id", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rpcId", "")),
                                new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                    new JProperty("code", -32001),
                                    new JProperty("message", "Tool '" + (string)context.Variables["toolName"] + "' is not included in the '{tier}' plan. Tools in plan: {allowed-tools}")))).ToString())
                        
                    
                
                
            
            
            <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("surface", "") == "agent" && context.Request.Method == "POST")">
                
                    
                        
                            
                            
                            
                            
                        
                        
                            
                            
                                application/json
                            
                            
                                agent-denied
                            
                            
                                agent-entitlement
                            
                            
                                @(context.RequestId.ToString())
                            
                            @(new JObject(
                                new JProperty("jsonrpc", "2.0"),
                                new JProperty("id", context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("rpcId", "")),
                                new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                                    new JProperty("code", -32001),
                                    new JProperty("message", "Agent '" + (string)context.Variables["agentId"] + "' is not included in the '{tier}' plan. Upgrade the plan to delegate tasks to it.")))).ToString())
                        
                    
                
                
            
        
        
        <quota-by-key calls="{budget-micro-usd}" renewal-period="{budget-period-seconds}"
            counter-key="@("budget-" + context.Subscription?.Id + "-" + (string)context.Variables["budgetEpoch"])"
            increment-condition="@(context.Response.StatusCode == 200)"
            increment-count="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("costMicroUsd", 0))" />
